review_result.summary: The authentication service module has some security concerns and lacks proper validation.

issues.description: The validate_user method only checks for username length, it does not verify the user's password or check against a database of existing users.
issues.suggestion: Implement a more robust validation system that checks user credentials against a database and uses secure password hashing.

issues.description: The AuthManager class has an empty rate_limits dictionary, but it is not being used anywhere in the class.
issues.suggestion: Remove the rate_limits dictionary if it is not being used, or implement rate limiting functionality to prevent brute-force attacks.

issues.description: The validate_user method returns a boolean value, but it does not handle any exceptions that may occur during validation.
issues.suggestion: Add try-except blocks to handle any exceptions that may occur during validation and provide more informative error messages.
